## Safety review

- [ ] I traced all callers, writers, processes, and side effects in scope.
- [ ] Formula/unit/precision/rounding and boundary behavior are unchanged or
      intentionally documented and tested.
- [ ] Exchange, persistence, restart, concurrency, partial-failure, and
      ownership paths were reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] I identified every affected Binance/Supabase/VPS/local boundary and
      verified environment differences or marked them explicitly unverified.
- [ ] Data/schema changes include validation and rollback/forward recovery.
- [ ] Current official primary documentation was checked for unstable external
      behavior; links and access dates are below.
- [ ] A regression or characterization test covers the change when practical.
- [ ] I did not weaken tests, hide failures, or mix unrelated cleanup/upgrades.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] I inspected the final diff and preserved pre-existing work.
